verse.verse_1: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
verse.verse_3: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
verse.verse_4: And thy garments keep free from stain!
verse.verse_6: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
verse.verse_7: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
verse.verse_8: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
verse.verse_9: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
verse.verse_10: Far from easy for those without Faith.
verse.verse_11: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
verse.verse_12: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
verse.verse_13: And sons to be by his side!-
verse.verse_14: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
verse.verse_15: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
verse.verse_16: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
verse.verse_17: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
verse.verse_18: For he thought and he plotted;-
verse.verse_19: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
verse.verse_20: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
verse.verse_22: Then he frowned and he scowled;
verse.verse_23: Then he turned back and was haughty;
verse.verse_24: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
verse.verse_25: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
verse.verse_26: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
verse.verse_27: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
verse.verse_28: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
verse.verse_29: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
verse.verse_31: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
verse.verse_33: And by the Night as it retreateth,
verse.verse_34: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
verse.verse_35: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
verse.verse_37: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
verse.verse_38: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
verse.verse_39: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
verse.verse_40: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
verse.verse_43: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
verse.verse_44: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
verse.verse_45: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
verse.verse_46: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
verse.verse_47: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
verse.verse_48: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
verse.verse_49: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
verse.verse_50: As if they were affrighted asses,
verse.verse_52: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
verse.verse_53: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
verse.verse_54: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
verse.verse_55: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
verse.verse_56: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
